text: clinical investigators, calculating sample size often critical step preparing grant proposals IRB submissions. Underpowered trials risk false-negative findings (\(P > 0.05\)), wasting research grants patient effort. Conversely, overpowered trials waste resources expose unnecessary subjects experimental risks. SampleSizeCalc package supports designs illustrated 52 clinical scenarios . example explains population, study procedures, endpoint, planning assumptions, result translates recruitment. teaching protocols. Except published numerical example explicitly identified, clinical effects, standard deviations, event rates, margins illustrative assumptions. methodological reference supports formula; establish clinical inputs. real protocol document source population, endpoint definition, follow-window, uncertainty planning input. Numerical interpretations evaluated R result objects site built. diagnostic branches convert unrounded requirement screening total; operational recruitment also respect integer case control quotas. Default reports contain plain-text formula, LaTeX source, calculation process, references.

title: SampleSizeCalc: A Comprehensive Guide to Sample Size Determination in Clinical Research
text: \(\alpha\) (Type Error / False Positive): probability declaring treatment effective truly — “probability convicting innocent drug” (conventionally 0.05). \(\text{Power} = 1 - \beta\) (True Positive Detection): probability catching true effect exists — “probability catching real culprit” (routinely 0.80 0.90). Continuous vs. Binary Endpoints: Continuous measures numerical values (systolic BP drop mmHg, fasting glucose mmol/L); binary measures event status (eradicated vs. , cured vs. ). Two-Sided vs. One-Sided: Two-sided tests differences either direction (classical RCTs); one-sided tests non-inferiority directional superiority. Dropout Rate (\(d\)): Inflation formula \(N_{\text{screen}} = \lceil N / (1 - d) \rceil\).

title: SampleSizeCalc: A Comprehensive Guide to Sample Size Determination in Clinical Research
text: Population decision: cardiology service plans blinded, parallel, 1:1 randomized trial adults aged 40–75 whose background antihypertensive treatment stable, comparing add-study drug add-placebo. Procedures endpoint: baseline week 12, use protocol average repeated seated BP readings. primary outcome baseline minus week-12 systolic BP, larger positive change means greater improvement; patient supplies one change score. Planning inputs: Assume mean reductions 10 12 mmHg common change-score SD 3 mmHg. map mean1, mean2, sd; SD baseline BP interchangeable SD change. Verify assumptions using comparable pilot external data. design: question whether two independent mean changes differ, using two-sided α=0.05 80% power. targeted -group difference 2 mmHg, distinct either group’s reduction baseline. Formula: \[n = 2\left(\frac{(Z_{\alpha/2} + Z_{\beta}) \cdot \sigma}{\mu_1 - \mu_2}\right)^2\] Chow, Shao, Wang & Lokhnygina (2017), Sample Size Calculations Clinical Research (3rd ed.), CRC Press. Result recruitment: 37 analyzable patients per arm, 74 total. report shows normal approximation 35.32 per arm noncentral t calculation rounding. 10% expected lack primary endpoint, plan 42 per arm (84 total); additional adjustment included RCT result.
code: res_1_1 <- calculate("rct", "test", "mean", mean1 = 10, mean2 = 12, sd = 3, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_1_1) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Two independent samples, mean comparison" #> • Sample size per group: 37 #> • Total sample size: 74 #> Formula (plain text): #> `n = 2 * ((Z_alpha/2 + Z_beta) * sd / (mean1 - mean2))^2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n = 2\left(\frac{Z_{\alpha/2} + Z_{\beta}}{\delta}\right)^2 = 2\left(\frac{(Z_{\alpha/2} + Z_{\beta}) \cdot \sigma}{\mu_1 - \mu_2}\right)^2$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: State hypotheses: H0: mu1 = mu2 vs H1: mu1 != mu2 (two-sided alpha = #> 0.05, power = 0.80). #> • Step 2: Calculate mean difference delta = |mu1 - mu2| = |10 - 12| = 2; common #> SD sigma = 3. #> • Step 3: Determine critical values: Z_(alpha/2) = 1.96 (for two-sided alpha = #> 0.05), Z_beta = 0.8416 (for power = 0.80). #> • Step 4: Compute initial sample size via normal approximation: n0 = 2 * #> ((Z_(alpha/2) + Z_beta) * sigma / delta)^2 = 2 * ((1.96 + 0.8416) * 3 / 2)^2 = #> 35.32. #> • Step 5: Refine via exact two-sample Student's t-test power iteration #> (accounting for degrees of freedom df = 2n - 2). #> • Step 6: Round up to integer: n = 37 per group, total sample size N = 74. #> Reference: #> Chow, S. C., Shao, J., Wang, H., & Lokhnygina, Y. (2017). Sample Size Calculations in Clinical Research (3rd ed.). CRC Press. Chapter 3 (Comparing Means), Section 3.2.1 two-sample parallel design, Eq 3.11 (p. 48; the Student t refinement is Table 3.2, p. 49). #>  #>  Also: Machin et al. (2018) Eq 5.4, p. 69 (same formula with the Student t correction term). #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

title: SampleSizeCalc: A Comprehensive Guide to Sample Size Determination in Clinical Research
text: Population decision: gastroenterology trial enrolls adults confirmed H. pylori infection eligible either two 14-day regimens, recent antibiotic use previous eradication failure handled prespecified eligibility rules. Procedures endpoint: Determine eradication standardized urea breath test fixed post-treatment window. Define medication restrictions, invalid tests, repeat assessments advance; improvement symptoms treatment completion eradication endpoint. Planning inputs: Illustrative rates p1 = 0.85 p2 = 0.70, absolute difference 15 percentage points. Actual sources must match treatment history, resistance setting, timing definition eradication. design: Different patients form two groups, use independent proportions two-sided α=0.05 80% power. Prespecify nonadherence missing follow-enter analysis. Formula (Fleiss asymptotic): \[n = \frac{\left[Z_{\alpha/2}\sqrt{2\bar{p}(1-\bar{p})} + Z_{\beta}\sqrt{p_1(1-p_1)+p_2(1-p_2)}\right]^2}{(p_1-p_2)^2}\] Fleiss, Tytun & Ury (1980), Biometrics 36(2), 343-346. Result recruitment: 121 patients per arm, 242 total. Allowing 10% missing primary endpoints gives 135 per arm 270 total; analysis population missing-data strategy still require explicit definitions.
code: res_1_2 <- calculate("rct", "test", "proportion", p1 = 0.85, p2 = 0.70, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_1_2) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Two independent proportions" #> • Sample size per group: 121 #> • Total sample size: 242 #> Formula (plain text): #> `n = (Z_a/2 * sqrt(2*p_bar*(1-p_bar)) + Z_b * sqrt(p1*(1-p1)+p2*(1-p2)))^2 / #> (p1-p2)^2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n = \frac{\left[Z_{\alpha/2}\sqrt{2\bar{p}(1-\bar{p})} + Z_{\beta}\sqrt{p_1(1-p_1) + p_2(1-p_2)}\right]^2}{(p_1 - p_2)^2}$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: State hypotheses: H0: p1 = p2 vs H1: p1 != p2 (two-sided alpha = #> 0.05, power = 0.80). #> • Step 2: Compute pooled proportion: p_bar = (p1 + p2) / 2 = (0.85 + 0.70) / 2 #> = 0.775. #> • Step 3: Determine critical values: Z_(alpha/2) = 1.96, Z_beta = 0.8416. #> • Step 4: Compute Fleiss formula numerator components: #> Z_(alpha/2)*sqrt(2*p_bar*(1-p_bar)) = 1.1575; Z_beta*sqrt(p1(1-p1)+p2(1-p2)) = #> 0.4889. #> • Step 5: Calculate unrounded sample size per group: n = (1.1575 + 0.4889)^2 / #> (0.85 - 0.70)^2 = 120.47. #> • Step 6: Round up to integer: n = 121 per group, total sample size N = 242. #> Reference: #> Primary (formula as implemented, without continuity correction): Fleiss, J. L., Tytun, A., & Ury, H. K. (1980). A simple approximation for calculating sample sizes for comparing independent proportions. Biometrics, 36(2), 343-346. #>  #> With continuity correction: Casagrande, J. T., Pike, M. C., & Smith, P. G. (1978). An improved approximate formula for calculating sample sizes for comparing two binomial distributions. Biometrics, 34(3), 483-494. #>  #> Book: Fleiss, J. L., Levin, B., & Paik, M. C. (2003). Statistical methods for rates and proportions (3rd ed.). Wiley. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

text: Population decision: oncology group plans 1:1 randomized trial advanced non-small-cell lung cancer patients eligible study regimens, follow-measured randomization. Procedures endpoint: Specify overall survival primary outcome, death cause event last confirmed survival censoring date. Progression overall-survival event; progression-free survival design needs event definition assumptions. Planning inputs: Assume proportional hazards, hr = 0.70, experimental allocation pE = 0.50, two-sided α=0.05, 80% power. hazard ratio ratio two fixed-time death probabilities. design: First determine number deaths required. Accrual duration, additional follow-, survival distributions, losses determine fraction recruited patients contribute event analysis feasible. Formula (Schoenfeld): \[E = \frac{(Z_{\alpha/2} + Z_{\beta})^2}{p_E(1 - p_E)[\ln(HR)]^2}\] Schoenfeld (1983), Biometrics 39(2), 499-503. Result recruitment: 247 deaths required. separate accrual follow-model predicts event fraction 60% analysis, rough resource estimate 412 patients. fraction additional assumption, output derived HR function.
code: res_1_3 <- calculate("rct", "test", "survival", hr = 0.70, pE = 0.50, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_1_3) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Survival (log-rank)" #> • Events needed: 247 #> Formula (plain text): #> `E = (Z_a/2 + Z_b)^2 / (pE*(1-pE)*log(HR)^2)` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$E = \frac{(Z_{\alpha/2} + Z_{\beta})^2}{p_E(1-p_E)[\ln(HR)]^2}$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: State survival parameters: Hazard Ratio HR = 0.70, experimental arm #> allocation pE = 0.50 (alpha = 0.05, power = 0.80). #> • Step 2: Compute log hazard ratio: ln(HR) = ln(0.70) = -0.3567. #> • Step 3: Determine critical values: Z_(alpha/2) = 1.96, Z_beta = 0.8416. #> • Step 4: Apply Schoenfeld formula: E = (Z_(alpha/2) + Z_beta)^2 / [pE * (1 - #> pE) * (ln HR)^2] = (1.96 + 0.8416)^2 / [0.50 * 0.50 * (-0.3567)^2] = 246.79. #> • Step 5: Round up to integer: Target events needed E = 247. #> Reference: #> Primary: Schoenfeld, D. A. (1983). Sample-size formula for the proportional-hazards regression model. Biometrics, 39(2), 499-503. #>  #> Extensions: #> - Hsieh, F. Y., & Lavori, P. W. (2000). Sample-size calculations for the Cox proportional hazards regression model with nonbinary covariates. Controlled Clinical Trials, 21(6), 552-560. #> - Rubinstein, L. V., Gail, M. H., & Santner, T. J. (1981). Planning the duration of a comparative clinical trial with loss to follow-up and a period of continued observation. Journal of Chronic Diseases, 34(9-10), 469-479. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

text: Population decision: randomized parallel trial compares lower-cost symptom-management strategy usual care patients symptomatic diabetic peripheral neuropathy, keeping background treatment stable. Procedures endpoint: Use improvement baseline week 12 prespecified symptom scale, larger reductions indicating benefit. Standardize assessment require sufficient baseline symptoms avoid pronounced floor effect. Planning inputs: Assume improvements 10 9.5 points, SD=3, maximum acceptable loss margin = 1 point. Justify margin using clinical importance established comparator effect; chosen anticipated difference alone. design: Demonstrate study minus control improvement exceeds −1 point. example uses one-sided α=0.05 80% power; protocol choosing one-sided 0.025 must recalculate accordingly. Formula: \[n = 2\left(\frac{(Z_{\alpha} + Z_{\beta})\sigma}{\mu_1 - \mu_2 + \Delta}\right)^2\] Chow et al. (2017), Chapter 4. Result recruitment: 50 per arm, 100 total. Document primary analysis population, adherence handling, missing outcomes alongside margin justification; part non-inferiority design.
code: res_1_4 <- calculate("rct", "noninferiority", "mean", mean1 = 10, mean2 = 9.5, sd = 3, margin = 1, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_1_4) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Non-inferiority (means)" #> • Sample size per group: 50 #> • Total sample size: 100 #> Formula (plain text): #> `n = 2*(Z_a+Z_b)^2*sd^2/(mean1-mean2+margin)^2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n = 2\left(\frac{(Z_{\alpha} + Z_{\beta})\sigma}{\mu_1 - \mu_2 + \Delta}\right)^2$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: State non-inferiority hypotheses: H0: mu1 - mu2 <= -margin vs H1: mu1 #> - mu2 > -margin (margin Delta = 1, one-sided alpha = 0.05, power = 0.80). #> • Step 2: Effective difference: delta_E = mu1 - mu2 + margin = 10 - 9.50 + 1 = #> 1.50; SD sigma = 3. #> • Step 3: Determine critical values: one-sided Z_alpha = 1.6449, Z_beta = #> 0.8416. #> • Step 4: Compute sample size: n = 2 * (Z_alpha + Z_beta)^2 * sigma^2 / #> delta_E^2 = 2 * (1.6449 + 0.8416)^2 * 3^2 / (1.50)^2 = 49.46. #> • Step 5: Round up to integer: n = 50 per group, total sample size N = 100. #> Reference: #> Chow, S. C., Shao, J., Wang, H., & Lokhnygina, Y. (2017). Sample Size Calculations in Clinical Research (3rd ed.). CRC Press. Chapter 3 (Comparing Means), Section 3.2.2 noninferiority, Eq 3.12, p. 50. #>  #>  Also: Machin et al. (2018) Eq 11.3, p. 173. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

text: Population decision: adult lower urinary tract infection trial compares convenient study regimen effective active comparator, using consistent microbiological eligibility criteria. Procedures endpoint: Define clinical cure fixed post-treatment visit window, prespecified rules rescue treatment, antibiotic switching, missing visits. patient contributes one binary outcome. Planning inputs: Assume cure rates 85%, maximum acceptable absolute loss 5 percentage points: p1 = p2 = 0.85, margin = 0.05. margin illustrative requires clinical effect-preservation justification. design: Use one-sided α=0.05 80% power exclude unacceptable reduction cure. nonsignificant ordinary difference test establish non-inferiority. text: Population decision: knee osteoarthritis trial randomizes patients sufficient baseline pain study topical preparation active comparator, seeking improvement beyond prespecified clinically relevant difference. Procedures endpoint: Measure baseline--week-12 reduction specified WOMAC pain subscale, standardized assessments rules rescue medication measurement. Planning inputs: Assume reductions 12 versus 10 points, SD=3, margin = 1 point. effective difference 12−10−1=1 point; using full anticipated 2-point difference denominator answer different question. design: superiority beyond positive margin, one-sided α=0.05 80% power. Specify scale version, score direction, clinical reasoning margin observing results. Formula: \[n = 2\left(\frac{(Z_{\alpha} + Z_{\beta})\sigma}{\mu_1 - \mu_2 - \Delta}\right)^2\] Chow et al. (2017). Result recruitment: 112 per arm, 224 total. Recruitment must deliver required primary endpoints; changing margin observing outcomes change original scientific question.

text: Population decision: parallel randomized study compares two formulations patients stable hypothyroidism stable background dosing, allowing sufficient time prespecified steady-state assessment. Procedures endpoint: teaching example uses mean steady-state total serum thyroxine, standardized sampling time laboratory platform. illustrates equivalence continuous pharmacodynamic endpoint, complete bioequivalence interchangeability assessment. Planning inputs: Assume means 10 10.2 μg/dL, SD=3 μg/dL, equivalence corridor ±1 μg/dL. SD margins require endpoint-specific clinical pilot evidence. design: unacceptable directions must excluded using equivalence testing, one-sided α=0.05 target power 80%. Failure find difference establish equivalence. Formula (TOST): \[n = 2\left(\frac{(Z_{\alpha} + Z_{\beta/2})\sigma}{\Delta - |\mu_1 - \mu_2|}\right)^2\] Chow et al. (2017). Result recruitment: 241 per arm, 482 total. requirement concerns single defined continuous endpoint; additional primary pharmacokinetic outcomes need planning.

text: Population decision: anesthesia service randomizes adults undergoing type surgery two postoperative analgesic regimens, asking whether convenient regimen provides sufficiently similar response rates. Procedures endpoint: Define success advance, example meeting specified pain-reduction threshold without rescue medication first 6 hours. Prespecify rescue use, early withdrawal, repeated pain observations form one patient-level result. Planning inputs: Assume response rates 50% 52%, equivalence corridor ±10 percentage points: p1 = 0.50, p2 = 0.52, margin = 0.10. design: Use equivalence independent proportions, one-sided α=0.05 80% power. margin must justified response definition rather treated universal analgesic standard. Formula: \[n = \frac{(Z_{\alpha}+Z_{\beta/2})^2\left[p_1(1-p_1)+p_2(1-p_2)\right]}{(\Delta-|p_1-p_2|)^2}\] Chow et al. (2017). Result recruitment: 669 per arm, 1338 total. count independent patients primary outcomes, number repeated pain assessments.

C., Shao, J., Wang, H., & Lokhnygina, Y. (2017). Sample Size Calculations in Clinical Research (3rd ed.). CRC Press. Chapter 4 (Large Sample Tests for Proportions), Section 4.2.3 equivalence, Eq 4.9 (p. 79). #>  #>  Also: Machin et al. (2018) Eq 11.5-11.6, p. 174. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

text: Population decision: chronic-disease clinic introduces medication reminder program one cohort compares adherence success program week 8. Procedures endpoint: Apply prespecified adherence threshold periods. patient forms paired binary record; question whether success rises 60% 80%, comparison independent cohorts. Planning inputs: Set post-program p1 = 0.80, baseline p2 = 0.60, discordant proportion psi = 0.25. implies 22.5% changing failure success 2.5% changing opposite direction; verify pattern using paired pilot records. design: McNemar/Connor planning uses discordant pairs, two-sided α=0.05 80% power. measurements needed complete pair. Result recruitment: 47 patients complete pairs, 94 assessments. 90% paired completion, recruit 53 patients; doubling observations double number distinct people.

what: 2.5 Phase II Simon’s Optimal Two-Stage Design
title: SampleSizeCalc: A Comprehensive Guide to Sample Size Determination in Clinical Research
text: Population decision: single-arm phase-II sarcoma study enrolls patients measurable advanced disease consistent previous treatment eligibility, seeking early termination regimen inadequate activity. Procedures endpoint: Confirm objective response approximately 8 weeks using prespecified criteria. Allow stage-1 patients reach assessment window verify outcomes formal continuation decision. Planning inputs: Set unacceptable response rate p0 = 0.10, promising rate p1 = 0.30, one-sided α=0.05, 80% power. rates must refer disease subgroup response definition. design: optimizer = "optimal" minimizes expected enrollment null, potentially accepting larger maximum total minimax design. Formula: exact binomial enumeration (Simon 1989). design \((r_1/n_1, r/n)\) satisfies \[P_p(\text{reject }H_0) = \sum_{x_1=r_1+1}^{n_1}\binom{n_1}{x_1}p^{x_1}(1-p)^{n_1-x_1}\,P_p(X_2 > r-x_1), \quad P_{p_0}(\text{reject }H_0)\le\alpha\] analogous expression \(p_1\) must reach target power. Simon (1989), Controlled Clinical Trials 10(1), 1-10. Result stopping rules: Enroll 10 initially stop futility responses ≤1. Otherwise add 19 patients maximum 29. Reject null total responses exceed 5 (least 6). Stage 1 included maximum total.
code: res_2_5 <- calculate("singleArmPhaseII", "test", "proportion", p0 = 0.10, p1 = 0.30, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8, optimizer = "optimal") print(res_2_5) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Single-arm phase II (Simon two-stage, optimal)" #> • Stage 1 sample size: 10 #> • Stage 1 futility boundary (stop if responses <= r1): 1 #> • Total sample size (both stages): 29 #> • Overall boundary (declare effective if responses > r): 5 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • p0 = unacceptable response rate (null) #> • p1 = desirable response rate (alternative) #> • stage 1: stop for futility if responses <= r_stage_1 of n_stage_1 #> • overall: declare effective if responses > r_total of n_total #> Formula (plain text): #> `exact binomial: P(effective|p0) <= alpha and P(effective|p1) >= power` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$P(\text{reject } H_0 \mid p_0) \le \alpha \quad \text{and} \quad P(\text{reject } H_0 \mid p_1) \ge 1-\beta$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: State phase II hypotheses: H0: p <= 0.10 (unacceptable) vs H1: p >= #> 0.30 (promising) (alpha = 0.05, power = 0.80). #> • Step 2: Exhaustive exact binomial search under 'optimal' criterion. #> • Step 3: Stage 1: Accrue n1 = 10 patients; stop early for futility if #> responses <= r1 = 1. #> • Step 4: Stage 2: If > 1 responses observed, accrue additional 19 patients up #> to total n = 29. #> • Step 5: Final decision: Declare effective if total responses > r = 5 #> (Expected sample size under H0 = 15). #> Reference: #> Primary: Simon, R. (1989). Optimal two-stage designs for phase II clinical trials. Controlled Clinical Trials, 10(1), 1-10. #>  #>  Also: Machin et al. (2018) Chapter 17 (Therapeutic Exploratory Trials). #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

id: 引言为什么样本量计算是临床研究的第一生命线
what: 引言：为什么样本量计算是临床研究的第一生命线？
title: SampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 很多临床医生在申报国家自然科学基金、撰写临床试验方案（Protocol）或提交伦理审查时，最容易被评审专家质疑的就是样本量计算依据。 不经严谨测算就随意定一个样本量（比如“凭经验随访 50 例”），会面临两大致命风险： 1. 样本量过小（Underpowered，检验效能不足）：哪怕药物真有疗效，因为人数太少，微弱的信号会被人体的抽样波动彻底掩盖，最终 \(P > 0.05\)，得出“无统计学显著差异”的假阴性结论，浪费科研经费与受试者心血。 2. 样本量过大（Overpowered，不符合医学伦理）：纳入过多患者不仅拖延试验周期，更在伦理上让多余的受试者暴露在未知疗效或有潜在副作用的试验药物中。 SampleSizeCalc（临床研究样本量计算器）覆盖了经典双臂 RCT、流行病学调查、Simon 两阶段试验、生物等效性、诊断试验及预测模型等设计。本指南用 52 个临床场景说明如何把研究问题转成计算参数。 下面的研究方案均为教学示例。除明确标注的教材数值例题外，治疗效果、标准差、发生率及界值是演示假设；公式的参考文献不代表这些临床参数已有实证支持。实际方案应记录参数来自哪项同类研究、哪批先导数据，以及人群、随访时间和结局定义是否一致。 每个场景依次说明研究人群、实施流程、参数设定和设计选择。结果解读中的数值由 R 对象直接生成。部分诊断分支先用未取整样本量换算筛查数；招募计划还应按已取整的病例配额换算，并分别保证疾病阳性与阴性受试者数量。 默认打印计算结果时，会同时显示纯文本公式、LaTeX 公式源码、计算过程和参考文献，并按设计提供参数角色说明。 赋值保存结果后，输入对象名称或调用 print() 即可查看；summary() 还会列出全部输入参数及已记录的调整。

id: 统计零基础必读核心概念通俗白话字典
what: 统计零基础必读：核心概念通俗白话字典
title: SampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 通俗比喻：“法官冤枉好人的概率”。新药明明没有用，但巧合之下我们误认为新药有用的概率。 常规取值：国际学术界惯例设为 0.05（即 5%）。单侧检验（如非劣效试验）常设为 0.025 或 0.05。 通俗比喻：“警察抓出真凶的把握”。新药确实有用时，我们的试验能以多大的概率把它检测出来。 常规取值：通常设为 0.80（80%） 或 0.90（90%）。把握度要求越高，需要招募的患者越多。 连续型指标：测量出来是具体数值，如收缩压降幅（mmHg）、空腹血糖（mmol/L）。核心参数是“均数差（\(\Delta\)）”与“标准差（\(\sigma\), SD）”。 二分类指标：只有“有效/无效”、“治愈/未治愈”，如有效率 80%、死亡率 15%。 双侧检验：事先不确定新药到底会比对照组好还是差，两头都看（经典临床试验通用）。 单侧检验：只关心新药是否优于对照药，或者新药是否“不差于”对照药（非劣效/优效性试验通用）。 随访中患者失访或退出。设计划脱落率为 \(d\)（如 10%），目标样本量需放大：\(N_{\text{screen}} = \lceil N / (1 - d) \rceil\)。

id: 核心语法统一三轴入口-calculate
what: 核心语法：统一三轴入口 calculate()
title: SampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 在 SampleSizeCalc 中，所有计算统一汇聚为一个函数： \[\Large \texttt{calculate(design, task, outcome, ...)}\] 第一轴 design（设计类型）：我们在做什么类型的研究？（"rct", "paired", "cohort", "caseControl", "diagAccuracy", "diagAUC", "singleArmPhaseII", "bioequivalence", "clusterRCT" 等） 第二轴 task（统计任务）：科学目的是什么？（"test" 假设检验, "estimate" 置信区间精度, "noninferiority" 非劣效, "superiority" 优效, "equivalence" 等效） 第三轴 outcome（结局指标）：如何度量疗效？（"mean" 均数, "proportion" 比例, "survival" 生存事件数, "auc" 诊断AUC, "rate" 人时率）

id: 两独立样本均数比较连续变量
previous_headings: 第一章：随机对照试验（RCT）全场景实战
what: 1.1 两独立样本均数比较（连续变量）
title: SampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 研究背景与人群：心内科拟开展两臂、双盲、平行随机试验，纳入 40–75 岁、基础降压方案稳定的门诊患者，比较加用研究药与加用安慰剂的效果，按 1:1 分组。 实施与主要结局：基线和第 12 周均按统一流程取多次坐位血压的平均值。主要结局是“基线减去第 12 周”的收缩压降幅，正值越大表示改善越多；每名患者贡献一个连续结局。 参数设定与依据：演示假设对照组平均下降 10 mmHg、研究药组下降 12 mmHg，个体降幅的合并 SD 为 3 mmHg。mean1 = 10、mean2 = 12、sd = 3 对应这些量，不能用基线血压 SD 替代降幅 SD。正式取值需核对同类人群、相同测量流程的先导资料。 设计选择：问题是两组平均降幅是否不同，因此使用双侧 alpha = 0.05、power = 0.8 的两独立样本均数比较；这里的 2 mmHg 是拟检出的组间差，不是每组各自的治疗效果。 数学公式与出处： \[n = 2 \left( \frac{(Z_{\alpha/2} + Z_{\beta}) \cdot \sigma}{\mu_1 - \mu_2} \right)^2\] 出处：Chow, S. C., Shao, J., Wang, H., & Lokhnygina, Y. (2017). Sample Size Calculations Clinical Research (3rd ed.). CRC Press. 参数说明：mean1, mean2 为两组均值；sd 为合并标准差（\(>0\)）。 输出解读与招募安排：每组需 37 名可分析患者，总计 74 人。报告先列出正态近似的每组约 35.32 人，再通过非中心 t 分布效能求解并取整。若另预计 10% 的主要结局无法获得，则应按每组向上取整，计划招募 42 人/组、共 84 人；该调整尚未包含在上述 RCT 结果中。
code: res_1_1 <- calculate("rct", "test", "mean", mean1 = 10, mean2 = 12, sd = 3, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_1_1) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Two independent samples, mean comparison" #> • Sample size per group: 37 #> • Total sample size: 74 #> Formula (plain text): #> `n = 2 * ((Z_alpha/2 + Z_beta) * sd / (mean1 - mean2))^2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n = 2\left(\frac{Z_{\alpha/2} + Z_{\beta}}{\delta}\right)^2 = 2\left(\frac{(Z_{\alpha/2} + Z_{\beta}) \cdot \sigma}{\mu_1 - \mu_2}\right)^2$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: State hypotheses: H0: mu1 = mu2 vs H1: mu1 != mu2 (two-sided alpha = #> 0.05, power = 0.80). #> • Step 2: Calculate mean difference delta = |mu1 - mu2| = |10 - 12| = 2; common #> SD sigma = 3. #> • Step 3: Determine critical values: Z_(alpha/2) = 1.96 (for two-sided alpha = #> 0.05), Z_beta = 0.8416 (for power = 0.80). #> • Step 4: Compute initial sample size via normal approximation: n0 = 2 * #> ((Z_(alpha/2) + Z_beta) * sigma / delta)^2 = 2 * ((1.96 + 0.8416) * 3 / 2)^2 = #> 35.32. #> • Step 5: Refine via exact two-sample Student's t-test power iteration #> (accounting for degrees of freedom df = 2n - 2). #> • Step 6: Round up to integer: n = 37 per group, total sample size N = 74. #> Reference: #> Chow, S. C., Shao, J., Wang, H., & Lokhnygina, Y. (2017). Sample Size Calculations in Clinical Research (3rd ed.). CRC Press. Chapter 3 (Comparing Means), Section 3.2.1 two-sample parallel design, Eq 3.11 (p. 48; the Student t refinement is Table 3.2, p. 49). #>  #>  Also: Machin et al. (2018) Eq 5.4, p. 69 (same formula with the Student t correction term). #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

id: 两独立样本比例比较二分类治愈率
previous_headings: 第一章：随机对照试验（RCT）全场景实战
what: 1.2 两独立样本比例比较（二分类治愈率）
title: SampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 研究背景与人群：消化内科拟纳入经检测确认幽门螺杆菌感染、尚未接受本轮根除治疗的成年人，随机比较两种 14 天治疗方案；近期抗菌药使用和既往根除失败应按方案预先处理。 实施与主要结局：疗程结束后按统一时间窗进行尿素呼气试验，预先定义停药要求及无效检测的处理。主要结局是每位受试者是否达到根除标准，不能把服药结束时症状好转当作根除。 参数设定与依据：以 p1 = 0.85、p2 = 0.70 演示预期根除率，目标是检出 15 个百分点的绝对差异。真实取值应来自治疗史、耐药背景、根除判定时间相近的研究或本中心数据。 设计选择：两组由不同患者构成，使用独立两比例比较，双侧 α=0.05、效能 80%。意向性分析如何处理漏服药和未完成复查，应在招募前写入方案。 数学公式与出处： \[n = \frac{\left[ Z_{\alpha/2}\sqrt{2\bar{p}(1-\bar{p})} + Z_{\beta}\sqrt{p_1(1-p_1) + p_2(1-p_2)} \right]^2}{(p_1 - p_2)^2}\] 出处：Fleiss, J. L., Tytun, ., & Ury, H. K. (1980). Biometrics, 36(2), 343-346. 输出解读与招募安排：每组需要 121 人，总计 242 人。若招募资源估计需预留 10% 的主要结局缺失，可计划 135 人/组、共 270 人；最终分析集及缺失数据策略仍需预先规定。
code: res_1_2 <- calculate("rct", "test", "proportion", p1 = 0.85, p2 = 0.70, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_1_2) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Two independent proportions" #> • Sample size per group: 121 #> • Total sample size: 242 #> Formula (plain text): #> `n = (Z_a/2 * sqrt(2*p_bar*(1-p_bar)) + Z_b * sqrt(p1*(1-p1)+p2*(1-p2)))^2 / #> (p1-p2)^2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n = \frac{\left[Z_{\alpha/2}\sqrt{2\bar{p}(1-\bar{p})} + Z_{\beta}\sqrt{p_1(1-p_1) + p_2(1-p_2)}\right]^2}{(p_1 - p_2)^2}$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: State hypotheses: H0: p1 = p2 vs H1: p1 != p2 (two-sided alpha = #> 0.05, power = 0.80). #> • Step 2: Compute pooled proportion: p_bar = (p1 + p2) / 2 = (0.85 + 0.70) / 2 #> = 0.775. #> • Step 3: Determine critical values: Z_(alpha/2) = 1.96, Z_beta = 0.8416. #> • Step 4: Compute Fleiss formula numerator components: #> Z_(alpha/2)*sqrt(2*p_bar*(1-p_bar)) = 1.1575; Z_beta*sqrt(p1(1-p1)+p2(1-p2)) = #> 0.4889. #> • Step 5: Calculate unrounded sample size per group: n = (1.1575 + 0.4889)^2 / #> (0.85 - 0.70)^2 = 120.47. #> • Step 6: Round up to integer: n = 121 per group, total sample size N = 242. #> Reference: #> Primary (formula as implemented, without continuity correction): Fleiss, J. L., Tytun, A., & Ury, H. K. (1980). A simple approximation for calculating sample sizes for comparing independent proportions. Biometrics, 36(2), 343-346. #>  #> With continuity correction: Casagrande, J. T., Pike, M. C., & Smith, P. G. (1978). An improved approximate formula for calculating sample sizes for comparing two binomial distributions. Biometrics, 34(3), 483-494. #>  #> Book: Fleiss, J. L., Levin, B., & Paik, M. C. (2003). Statistical methods for rates and proportions (3rd ed.). Wiley. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

what: 1.3 生存分析与 Log-Rank 检验（时间-事件结局）
title: SampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 研究背景与人群：肿瘤科拟在符合两种治疗适应条件的晚期非小细胞肺癌患者中，按 1:1 随机比较研究方案与对照方案，随访从随机化之日开始。 实施与主要结局：主要结局设为总生存期，事件严格定义为任何原因死亡；存活患者在末次确认存活时间删失。若研究目标改为无进展生存期，需要重新定义事件并重新估计参数。 参数设定与依据：假设比例风险成立，拟检出 hr = 0.70，实验组分配比例 pE = 0.50，双侧 α=0.05、效能 80%。HR 是瞬时风险比，不能直接当成两个固定时点死亡率之比。 设计选择：本步先求所需死亡事件数。再根据计划入组期、追加随访期、预期生存曲线和失访情况估计事件成熟比例，才能制定需要招募多少患者及何时分析。 数学公式与出处： \[E = \frac{(Z_{\alpha/2} + Z_{\beta})^2}{p_E(1 - p_E) [\ln(HR)]^2}\] 出处：Schoenfeld, D. . (1983). Biometrics, 39(2), 499-503. 输出解读与招募安排：需要累计 247 例死亡事件。若另有入组与随访模型估计分析时约 60% 的受试者发生死亡，则资源规划的粗略人数为 412 人；60% 是另一个规划假设，并非本函数根据 HR 自动得到的结果。
code: res_1_3 <- calculate("rct", "test", "survival", hr = 0.70, pE = 0.50, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_1_3) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Survival (log-rank)" #> • Events needed: 247 #> Formula (plain text): #> `E = (Z_a/2 + Z_b)^2 / (pE*(1-pE)*log(HR)^2)` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$E = \frac{(Z_{\alpha/2} + Z_{\beta})^2}{p_E(1-p_E)[\ln(HR)]^2}$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: State survival parameters: Hazard Ratio HR = 0.70, experimental arm #> allocation pE = 0.50 (alpha = 0.05, power = 0.80). #> • Step 2: Compute log hazard ratio: ln(HR) = ln(0.70) = -0.3567. #> • Step 3: Determine critical values: Z_(alpha/2) = 1.96, Z_beta = 0.8416. #> • Step 4: Apply Schoenfeld formula: E = (Z_(alpha/2) + Z_beta)^2 / [pE * (1 - #> pE) * (ln HR)^2] = (1.96 + 0.8416)^2 / [0.50 * 0.50 * (-0.3567)^2] = 246.79. #> • Step 5: Round up to integer: Target events needed E = 247. #> Reference: #> Primary: Schoenfeld, D. A. (1983). Sample-size formula for the proportional-hazards regression model. Biometrics, 39(2), 499-503. #>  #> Extensions: #> - Hsieh, F. Y., & Lavori, P. W. (2000). Sample-size calculations for the Cox proportional hazards regression model with nonbinary covariates. Controlled Clinical Trials, 21(6), 552-560. #> - Rubinstein, L. V., Gail, M. H., & Santner, T. J. (1981). Planning the duration of a comparative clinical trial with loss to follow-up and a period of continued observation. Journal of Chronic Diseases, 34(9-10), 469-479. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

what: 1.4 均数非劣效性检验（Non-Inferiority, Mean）
title: SampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 研究背景与人群：拟在有症状的糖尿病周围神经病变患者中，比较一种成本较低的症状管理方案与常规方案，采用平行随机设计，并使合并治疗保持稳定。 实施与主要结局：以第 12 周相对基线的症状评分降幅为主要结局，降幅越大越好；量表范围、评估者培训及基线最低症状程度需预先规定，避免明显地板效应。 参数设定与依据：演示设研究组降幅为 10 分、对照组 9.5 分，SD 为 3 分，允许最大疗效损失 margin = 1 分。该界值应根据临床重要性及对照治疗既往效应论证，不能由本次预期差异反推。 设计选择：需要证明“研究组减对照组”的差值大于 −1 分，故采用非劣效性均数设计。本例单侧 α=0.05、效能 80%；正式方案如选用单侧 0.025，应按该值重新计算。 数学公式与出处： \[n = 2\left(\frac{(Z_{\alpha} + Z_{\beta})\sigma}{\mu_1 - \mu_2 + \Delta}\right)^2\] 出处：Chow et al. (2017) Chapter 4. 单侧 \(\alpha = 0.05\)。 输出解读与招募安排：需要 50 人/组、总计 100 人。方案应同时说明主要分析集、依从性处理和缺失结局策略；这些分析约定与非劣效界值的临床论证一起构成样本量依据。
code: res_1_4 <- calculate("rct", "noninferiority", "mean", mean1 = 10, mean2 = 9.5, sd = 3, margin = 1, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_1_4) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Non-inferiority (means)" #> • Sample size per group: 50 #> • Total sample size: 100 #> Formula (plain text): #> `n = 2*(Z_a+Z_b)^2*sd^2/(mean1-mean2+margin)^2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n = 2\left(\frac{(Z_{\alpha} + Z_{\beta})\sigma}{\mu_1 - \mu_2 + \Delta}\right)^2$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: State non-inferiority hypotheses: H0: mu1 - mu2 <= -margin vs H1: mu1 #> - mu2 > -margin (margin Delta = 1, one-sided alpha = 0.05, power = 0.80). #> • Step 2: Effective difference: delta_E = mu1 - mu2 + margin = 10 - 9.50 + 1 = #> 1.50; SD sigma = 3. #> • Step 3: Determine critical values: one-sided Z_alpha = 1.6449, Z_beta = #> 0.8416. #> • Step 4: Compute sample size: n = 2 * (Z_alpha + Z_beta)^2 * sigma^2 / #> delta_E^2 = 2 * (1.6449 + 0.8416)^2 * 3^2 / (1.50)^2 = 49.46. #> • Step 5: Round up to integer: n = 50 per group, total sample size N = 100. #> Reference: #> Chow, S. C., Shao, J., Wang, H., & Lokhnygina, Y. (2017). Sample Size Calculations in Clinical Research (3rd ed.). CRC Press. Chapter 3 (Comparing Means), Section 3.2.2 noninferiority, Eq 3.12, p. 50. #>  #>  Also: Machin et al. (2018) Eq 11.3, p. 173. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

what: 1.5 比例非劣效性检验（Non-Inferiority, Proportion）
title: SampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 研究背景与人群：拟在病原学及入组标准一致的成人下尿路感染患者中，随机比较研究抗菌方案与有效对照方案，目标是评估较便利方案能否保持可接受的治愈效果。 实施与主要结局：在预设的治疗后访视窗口判定临床治愈，每位患者只有“治愈/未治愈”一个结局；救援治疗、提前更换抗菌药和失访的处理应预先统一。 参数设定与依据：演示假设两组治愈率均为 85%，可接受的最大绝对损失为 5 个百分点，即 p1 = p2 = 0.85、margin = 0.05。该界值是本例假设，须结合对照疗效保留和临床后果论证。 设计选择：检验研究组治愈率是否不低于对照组超过 5 个百分点，采用单侧 α=0.05、效能 80% 的非劣效两比例计算；不能用“组间差异不显著”代替非劣效结论。 数学公式与出处： \[n = \frac{(Z_{\alpha} + Z_{\beta})^2 [p_1(1-p_1) + p_2(1-p_2)]}{(p_1 - p_2 + \Delta)^2}\] 出处：Chow et al. (2017); Machin et al. (2018) Ch.11. 输出解读与招募安排：需 631 人/组、合计 1262 人。若主要结局完整率预计为 90%，按组预留后需 702 人/组；治疗失败不应被当成“脱落”而从治愈率分母中剔除。
code: res_1_5 <- calculate("rct", "noninferiority", "proportion", p1 = 0.85, p2 = 0.85, margin = 0.05, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_1_5) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Non-inferiority (proportions)" #> • Sample size per group: 631 #> • Total sample size: 1262 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • p1 = experimental-group response rate #> • p2 = active-control response rate #> • margin = non-inferiority margin Delta (one-sided alpha) #> Formula (plain text): #> `n = (Za+Zb)^2 * (p1q1+p2q2) / (p1-p2+margin)^2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n = \frac{(Z_{\alpha}+Z_{\beta})^2\left[p_1(1-p_1)+p_2(1-p_2)\right]}{(p_1-p_2+\Delta)^2}$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: State non-inferiority hypotheses: H0: p1 - p2 <= -margin vs H1: p1 - #> p2 > -margin (margin Delta = 0.05, one-sided alpha = 0.05, power = 0.80). #> • Step 2: Effective difference: delta_E = p1 - p2 + margin = 0.85 - 0.85 + 0.05 #> = 0.05. #> • Step 3: Determine critical values: one-sided Z_alpha = 1.6449, Z_beta = #> 0.8416. #> • Step 4: Compute sample size: n = (Z_alpha + Z_beta)^2 * [p1(1-p1) + p2(1-p2)] #> / delta_E^2 = 630.62. #> • Step 5: Round up to integer: n = 631 per group, total sample size N = 1262. #> Reference: #> Primary: Chow, S. C., Shao, J., Wang, H., & Lokhnygina, Y. (2017). Sample Size Calculations in Clinical Research (3rd ed.). CRC Press. Chapter 4 (Large Sample Tests for Proportions), Section 4.2.2 noninferiority/superiority, Eq 4.8 (p. 78). #>  #>  Also: Machin et al. (2018) Chapter 11, Eq 11.5-11.6, p. 174. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

title: SampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 研究背景与人群：风湿科拟在有足够基线疼痛程度的膝骨关节炎患者中，随机比较研究外用制剂与活性对照，研究目标是获得超过预设临床幅度的疼痛改善。 实施与主要结局：统一治疗 12 周，以 WOMAC 疼痛分量表的基线至终点降幅为连续结局，规定救援镇痛药的使用记录和评估前时间窗。 参数设定与依据：演示预期研究组降 12 分、对照组降 10 分，降幅 SD=3；margin = 1 分表示需要超过的组间差异。因此公式中的有效差为 12−10−1=1 分，不能把预期差 2 分直接作为分母。 设计选择：这是带正向界值的优效性检验，使用单侧 α=0.05、效能 80%。量表版本、分值方向及 1 分界值的临床意义应在正式方案中明确。 数学公式与出处： \[n = 2\left(\frac{(Z_{\alpha} + Z_{\beta})\sigma}{\mu_1 - \mu_2 - \Delta}\right)^2\] 出处：Chow et al. (2017). 单侧 \(\alpha = 0.05\)。 输出解读与招募安排：需 112 人/组、合计 224 人。招募计划应保证主要结局可获得；减少界值与增加预期差异会改变有效差，不能在观察到结果后再调整界值。
code: res_1_6 <- calculate("rct", "superiority", "mean", mean1 = 12, mean2 = 10, sd = 3, margin = 1, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_1_6) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Superiority (means)" #> • Sample size per group: 112 #> • Total sample size: 224 #> Formula (plain text): #> `n = 2*(Z_a+Z_b)^2*sd^2/(mean1-mean2-margin)^2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n = 2\left(\frac{(Z_{\alpha} + Z_{\beta})\sigma}{\mu_1 - \mu_2 - \Delta}\right)^2$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: State superiority hypotheses: H0: mu1 - mu2 <= margin vs H1: mu1 - #> mu2 > margin (margin Delta = 1, one-sided alpha = 0.05, power = 0.80). #> • Step 2: Effective difference: delta_E = mu1 - mu2 - margin = 12 - 10 - 1 = 1; #> SD sigma = 3. #> • Step 3: Determine critical values: one-sided Z_alpha = 1.6449, Z_beta = #> 0.8416. #> • Step 4: Compute sample size: n = 2 * (Z_alpha + Z_beta)^2 * sigma^2 / #> delta_E^2 = 2 * (1.6449 + 0.8416)^2 * 3^2 / (1)^2 = 111.29. #> • Step 5: Round up to integer: n = 112 per group, total sample size N = 224. #> Reference: #> Chow, S. C., Shao, J., Wang, H., & Lokhnygina, Y. (2017). Sample Size Calculations in Clinical Research (3rd ed.). CRC Press. Chapter 3 (Comparing Means), Section 3.2.2 superiority, Eq 3.12, p. 50. #>  #>  Also: Machin et al. (2018) Eq 11.3, p. 173. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

title: SampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 研究背景与人群：皮肤科拟在经真菌学确认的趾甲真菌病患者中，随机比较两种口服治疗方案；主要分析以患者为单位，并预先选定一个目标趾甲。 实施与主要结局：治疗后随访至预设的第 52 周，以临床清除与真菌学阴性同时达到定义“完全治愈”。疗程结束时的外观改善不能替代该长期结局。 参数设定与依据：演示治愈率为 30% 与 20%，研究要求真实差异超过 5 个百分点，故输入 p1 = 0.30、p2 = 0.20、margin = 0.05，有效差为 0.05。 设计选择：采用单侧 α=0.05、效能 80% 的带界值优效性两比例设计。参数资料需要匹配疾病严重程度、既往治疗和同样的治愈判定时间。 数学公式与出处： \[n = \frac{(Z_{\alpha} + Z_{\beta})^2 [p_1(1-p_1) + p_2(1-p_2)]}{(p_1 - p_2 - \Delta)^2}\] 出处：Chow et al. (2017). 输出解读与招募安排：需要 916 人/组、合计 1832 人。长随访应另估结局缺失比例；按 10% 预留时为 1018 人/组，且应规划治疗后复查容量。
code: res_1_7 <- calculate("rct", "superiority", "proportion", p1 = 0.30, p2 = 0.20, margin = 0.05, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_1_7) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Superiority (proportions)" #> • Sample size per group: 916 #> • Total sample size: 1832 #> Formula (plain text): #> `n = (Z_alpha + Z_beta)^2 * (p1*(1-p1) + p2*(1-p2)) / (p1 - p2 - margin)^2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n = \frac{(Z_{\alpha} + Z_{\beta})^2[p_1(1-p_1) + p_2(1-p_2)]}{(p_1 - p_2 - \Delta)^2}$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: State superiority hypotheses: H0: p1 - p2 <= margin vs H1: p1 - p2 > #> margin (margin Delta = 0.05, one-sided alpha = 0.05, power = 0.80). #> • Step 2: Effective difference: delta_E = p1 - p2 - margin = 0.30 - 0.20 - 0.05 #> = 0.05. #> • Step 3: Determine critical values: one-sided Z_alpha = 1.6449, Z_beta = #> 0.8416. #> • Step 4: Compute sample size: n = (Z_alpha + Z_beta)^2 * [p1(1-p1) + p2(1-p2)] #> / delta_E^2 = (1.6449 + 0.8416)^2 * [0.21 + 0.16] / (0.05)^2 = 915.02. #> • Step 5: Round up to integer: n = 916 per group, total sample size N = 1832. #> Reference: #> Chow, S. C., Shao, J., Wang, H., & Lokhnygina, Y. (2017). Sample Size Calculations in Clinical Research (3rd ed.). CRC Press. Chapter 4 (Large Sample Tests for Proportions), Section 4.2.2 noninferiority/ superiority, Eq 4.8 (p. 78). #>  #>  Also: Machin et al. (2018) Eq 11.5-11.6, p. 174; Fleiss, Tytun & Ury (1980), Biometrics 36(2), 343-346. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

title: SampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 研究背景与人群：拟在剂量及基础病情稳定的甲状腺功能减退患者中，随机比较两种制剂的药效学结局，两臂患者独立，终点评估前给予足够的稳态观察时间。 实施与主要结局：本例仅以稳态血清总甲状腺素均值作连续终点，统一采血时点与检验平台；它演示均数等效设计，不构成制剂生物等效性或可互换性的完整评价。 参数设定与依据：假设均值为 10 与 10.2 μg/dL、SD=3 μg/dL，预设等效范围 ±1 μg/dL，即 margin = 1。界值和 SD 均需由相应终点的临床与先导资料支撑。 设计选择：目标是把组间差异限制在两个边界以内，采用双单侧检验的等效性计算，单侧 α=0.05、整体目标效能 80%；“没有发现差异”并不等于等效。 数学公式与出处： \[n = 2\left(\frac{(Z_{\alpha} + Z_{\beta/2})\sigma}{\Delta - |\mu_1 - \mu_2|}\right)^2\] 出处：Chow et al. (2017). 输出解读与招募安排：需 241 人/组、合计 482 人。这里的样本量对应单个已定义连续终点；若另有主要终点或不同药代参数，应分别规划其统计要求。
code: res_1_8 <- calculate("rct", "equivalence", "mean", mean1 = 10, mean2 = 10.2, sd = 3, margin = 1, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_1_8) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Equivalence (means)" #> • Sample size per group: 241 #> • Total sample size: 482 #> Formula (plain text): #> `n = 2*(Z_a+Z_b/2)^2*sd^2/(margin-|mean1-mean2|)^2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n = 2\left(\frac{(Z_{\alpha} + Z_{\beta/2})\sigma}{\Delta - |\mu_1 - \mu_2|}\right)^2$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: State equivalence hypotheses (TOST): H0: |mu1 - mu2| >= margin vs H1: #> |mu1 - mu2| < margin (margin Delta = 1, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.80). #> • Step 2: Margin clearance: Delta - |mu1 - mu2| = 1 - |10 - 10.20| = 0.80; SD #> sigma = 3. #> • Step 3: Determine critical values: one-sided Z_alpha = 1.6449, Z_(beta/2) = #> 1.2816. #> • Step 4: Compute sample size: n = 2 * (Z_alpha + Z_(beta/2))^2 * sigma^2 / #> (Delta - |mu1 - mu2|)^2 = 2 * (1.6449 + 1.2816)^2 * 3^2 / (0.80)^2 = 240.86. #> • Step 5: Round up to integer: n = 241 per group, total sample size N = 482. #> Reference: #> Chow, S. C., Shao, J., Wang, H., & Lokhnygina, Y. (2017). Sample Size Calculations in Clinical Research (3rd ed.). CRC Press. Chapter 3 (Comparing Means), Section 3.2.3 equivalence, Eq 3.13, p. 51; the Z_{beta/2} convention is discussed in Section 3.6.1 (p. 67). #>  #>  Also: Machin et al. (2018) Eq 11.5-11.6, p. 174. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

previous_headings: 第一章：随机对照试验（RCT）全场景实战
title: SampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 研究背景与人群：麻醉科拟在接受相同类型手术的成人中，随机比较两种术后镇痛方案，评估在更便利给药条件下能否获得相近的镇痛成功率。 实施与主要结局：例如预先将“术后 6 小时内疼痛降幅达到规定标准且无需救援用药”定义为成功；明确救援用药、提前退出及多次疼痛记录的归并规则。 参数设定与依据：演示成功率为 50% 与 52%，可接受的绝对差异区间为 ±10 个百分点，对应 p1 = 0.50、p2 = 0.52、margin = 0.10。 设计选择：采用等效性两比例设计，单侧 α=0.05、效能 80%。界值应在揭盲前根据该成功定义的临床意义确定，并非通用于所有镇痛药的标准。 数学公式与出处： \[n = \frac{(Z_{\alpha} + Z_{\beta/2})^2 [p_1(1-p_1) + p_2(1-p_2)]}{(\Delta - |p_1 - p_2|)^2}\] 出处：Chow et al. (2017). 输出解读与招募安排：需 669 人/组、合计 1338 人。该人数对应完整的二分类主要终点，不能用多次疼痛测量次数替代独立患者数。
code: res_1_9 <- calculate("rct", "equivalence", "proportion", p1 = 0.50, p2 = 0.52, margin = 0.10, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_1_9) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Equivalence (proportions)" #> • Sample size per group: 669 #> • Total sample size: 1338 #> Formula (plain text): #> `n = (Z_alpha + Z_beta/2)^2 * (p1*(1-p1) + p2*(1-p2)) / (margin - |p1 - p2|)^2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n = \frac{(Z_{\alpha} + Z_{\beta/2})^2[p_1(1-p_1) + p_2(1-p_2)]}{(\Delta - |p_1-p_2|)^2}$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: State equivalence hypotheses (TOST): H0: |p1 - p2| >= margin vs H1: #> |p1 - p2| < margin (margin Delta = 0.10, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.80). #> • Step 2: Margin clearance: Delta - |p1 - p2| = 0.10 - |0.50 - 0.52| = 0.08. #> • Step 3: Determine critical values: one-sided Z_alpha = 1.6449, Z_(beta/2) = #> 1.2816. #> • Step 4: Compute sample size: n = (Z_alpha + Z_(beta/2))^2 * [p1(1-p1) + #> p2(1-p2)] / (Delta - |p1 - p2|)^2 = 668.52. #> • Step 5: Round up to integer: n = 669 per group, total sample size N = 1338. #> Reference: #> Chow, S. C., Shao, J., Wang, H., & Lokhnygina, Y. (2017). Sample Size Calculations in Clinical Research (3rd ed.). CRC Press. Chapter 4 (Large Sample Tests for Proportions), Section 4.2.3 equivalence, Eq 4.9 (p. 79). #>  #>  Also: Machin et al. (2018) Eq 11.5-11.6, p. 174. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

id: 配对均数比较自身前后对照
previous_headings: 第二章：配对、单臂与交叉临床试验
what: 2.1 配对均数比较（自身前后对照）
title: SampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 研究背景与人群：康复门诊拟对一组慢性腰痛患者实施 6 周标准化运动干预，在同一患者治疗前后各测量一次 0–10 分疼痛评分。 实施与主要结局：主要结局是每位患者的“基线评分减第 6 周评分”，预期平均改善 2 分；两次测量应使用相同量表和时间条件，并能够按患者配对。 参数设定与依据：输入 meanDiff = 2、sdDiff = 3，后者是患者内差值的 SD。它应来自成对先导数据，不能直接取治疗前或治疗后单次评分的 SD。 设计选择：采用双侧 α=0.05、效能 80% 的配对均数计算。一组前后研究可估计平均变化；如需区分自然病程与干预效应，还需要相应的对照研究设计。 数学公式与出处： \[n = \left(\frac{(Z_{\alpha/2} + Z_{\beta}) \cdot \sigma_d}{\mu_d}\right)^2\] 出处：Rosner, B. (2015). Fundamentals biostatistics (8th ed.). Cengage Learning. 输出解读与招募安排：需要 20 名患者完成前后两次评估，即 40 次测量。这里的一“对”是同一患者的两次观测，不能理解成两名患者；若预计 10% 不能完成配对，可招募 23 名患者。
code: res_2_1 <- calculate("paired", "test", "mean", meanDiff = 2, sdDiff = 3, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_2_1) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Paired means" #> • Total sample size: 20 #> • Pairs needed: 20 #> • Measurements required: 40 #> • Total individuals: 20 #> Formula (plain text): #> `n = ((Z_a/2 + Z_b) * sd_diff / mean_diff)^2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n = \left(\frac{(Z_{\alpha/2} + Z_{\beta}) \cdot \sigma_d}{\mu_d}\right)^2$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: State paired difference hypotheses: H0: mu_d = 0 vs H1: mu_d != 0 #> (alpha = 0.05, power = 0.80). #> • Step 2: Expected paired difference mu_d = 2, SD of differences sigma_d = 3. #> • Step 3: Determine critical values: Z_(alpha/2) = 1.96, Z_beta = 0.8416. #> • Step 4: Normal approximation: n0 = ((Z_(alpha/2) + Z_beta) * sigma_d / #> mu_d)^2 = ((1.96 + 0.8416) * 3 / 2)^2 = 17.66. #> • Step 5: Exact paired Student's t-test degrees of freedom iteration. #> • Step 6: Round up to integer: n = 20 pairs (total individuals = 20). #> Reference: #> Rosner, B. (2015). *Fundamentals of biostatistics* (8th ed.). Cengage Learning. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

previous_headings: 第二章：配对、单臂与交叉临床试验
title: SampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 研究背景与人群：慢病门诊拟在同一批患者中实施服药提醒项目，比较干预前与第 8 周达到预设服药依从性标准的比例。 实施与主要结局：以同一规则将每个时期判为达标或未达标，按患者形成 2×2 配对表。主要问题是达标率是否从 60% 提高至 80%，不是把两次随访当成两个独立样本。 参数设定与依据：用 p1 = 0.80 表示干预后比例、p2 = 0.60 表示干预前比例，并假设不一致配对占比 psi = 0.25。这相当于约 22.5% 由未达标变达标、2.5% 反向变化，需由配对先导资料判断是否合理。 设计选择：McNemar/Connor 计算利用不一致配对的信息，双侧 α=0.05、效能 80%。只有两期都完成评估的患者才能提供完整配对。 数学公式与出处： \[n_{\text{pairs}} = \frac{\left[ Z_{\alpha/2}\sqrt{\psi} + Z_{\beta}\sqrt{\psi - \delta^2} \right]^2}{\delta^2}, \quad \delta = |p_1 - p_2|\] 出处：Connor, R. J. (1987). Biometrics, 43(1), 207-211. 输出解读与招募安排：需要 47 名患者的完整配对记录，共 94 次评估。若预计配对完成率为 90%，应招募 53 人；输出中的两倍计数不表示需要同样数量的不同患者。
code: res_2_2 <- calculate("paired", "test", "proportion", p1 = 0.80, p2 = 0.60, psi = 0.25, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_2_2) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Paired binary outcomes (McNemar / Connor)" #> • Total sample size: 47 #> • Pairs needed: 47 #> • Measurements required: 94 #> • Total individuals: 47 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • p1/p2 = expected proportions (or sensitivities) in pairs #> • psi = expected discordant-pair proportion (pi10 + pi01) #> • output is in PAIRS of observations; within_subject uses one person per pair, #> matched_subjects uses two #> • n_measurements = 2 x pairs; total_individuals counts distinct people #> Formula (plain text): #> `n = [Za*sqrt(psi) + Zb*sqrt(psi-delta^2)]^2/delta^2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n = \frac{\left[Z_{\alpha/2}\sqrt{\psi} + Z_{\beta}\sqrt{\psi-\delta^2}\right]^2}{\delta^2}$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Paired binary parameters: p1 = 0.80, p2 = 0.60, discordant pair #> proportion psi = 0.25, difference delta = |p1 - p2| = 0.20. #> • Step 2: Determine critical values: Z_(alpha/2) = 1.96, Z_beta = 0.8416. #> • Step 3: Connor formula: n_pairs = [Z_(alpha/2)*sqrt(psi) + Z_beta*sqrt(psi - #> delta^2)]^2 / delta^2 = 46.63. #> • Step 4: Round up to integer: Pairs needed = 47. #> Reference: #> Primary: Connor, R. J. (1987). Sample size for testing differences in proportions for the paired-sample design. Biometrics, 43(1), 207-211. #>  #>  Also: Akoglu, H. (2022). Turkish Journal of Emergency Medicine, 22(4), Table 2 Eq 3b + Tables 6A/6B (uncorrected and Yates-corrected values). #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

id: 单臂试验对比已知常模均值
previous_headings: 第二章：配对、单臂与交叉临床试验
what: 2.3 单臂试验对比已知常模均值
title: SampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 研究背景与人群：罕见病康复项目拟评价一个训练方案后的恒定负荷运动耐力，因为可招募人群有限，先与可比历史队列的固定均值作单臂比较。 实施与主要结局：终点为第 8 周标准化运动试验中完整测得的耐力持续时间，单位分钟；不是存在删失的生存期。历史与本次试验应匹配入组病情、运动负荷和停止规则。 参数设定与依据：将历史均值作为固定 mu0 = 10 分钟，预期本次均值 mu1 = 12、SD sigma = 3 分钟，双侧 α=0.05、效能 80%。 设计选择：该单样本近似把历史均值当成无估计误差的常数。如果历史样本很小或测量方案不同，应将历史对照的不确定性纳入其他设计，而不能直接沿用本结果。 数学公式与出处： \[n = \frac{(Z_{\alpha/2} + Z_{\beta})^2 \sigma^2}{(\mu_1 - \mu_0)^2}\] 出处：Machin et al. (2018) Chapter 5. 输出解读与招募安排：需 18 名可分析患者，每人提供一次终点评估。若预计 10% 的运动测试无法完成，可安排 20 名患者；对照值的可比性仍是解释结果的关键。
code: res_2_3 <- calculate("rctSingleArm", "test", "mean", mu0 = 10, mu1 = 12, sigma = 3, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_2_3) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Single-arm trial (continuous, vs fixed value)" #> • Required sample size: 18 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • mu0 = reference/historical control mean (the null value) #> • mu1 = anticipated treatment mean #> • sigma = population standard deviation #> Formula (plain text): #> `n = (Za/2 + Zb)^2 * sigma^2 / (mu1-mu0)^2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n = \frac{(Z_{\alpha/2} + Z_{\beta})^2 \sigma^2}{(\mu_1 - \mu_0)^2}$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Single-arm continuous hypotheses: H0: mu = 10 vs H1: mu = 12, SD #> sigma = 3 (alpha = 0.05, power = 0.80). #> • Step 2: Effect size delta = |mu1 - mu0| = |12 - 10| = 2. #> • Step 3: Determine critical values: Z_(alpha/2) = 1.96, Z_beta = 0.8416. #> • Step 4: Sample size: n = (Z_(alpha/2) + Z_beta)^2 * sigma^2 / delta^2 = (1.96 #> + 0.8416)^2 * 3^2 / (2)^2 = 17.66. #> • Step 5: Round up to integer: Required sample size n = 18. #> Reference: #> Primary: Machin, D., Campbell, M. J., Tan, S. B., & Tan, S. H. (2018). Sample Sizes for Clinical, Laboratory and Epidemiology Studies (4th ed.). Wiley. Chapter 5 (Continuous Outcomes, single-sample comparison). #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

id: 单臂试验对比历史对照有效率
previous_headings: 第二章：配对、单臂与交叉临床试验
what: 2.4 单臂试验对比历史对照有效率
title: SampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 研究背景与人群：血液科拟在入组及既往治疗线数明确的复发/难治性淋巴瘤患者中，开展一个探索性单臂治疗研究，与固定的历史反应率进行比较。 实施与主要结局：在预设的第 90 天由统一标准评价是否达到客观缓解，明确缓解前死亡、救援治疗与无法评估的处理；分母按方案规定，不能只保留存活且完成影像复查者。 参数设定与依据：教学设历史反应率 p0 = 0.70、预期反应率 p1 = 0.80。正式值需来自相同治疗线数、反应标准及观察窗口的人群，避免把更早期患者的疗效作为历史对照。 设计选择：本例用双侧 α=0.05、效能 80% 的单臂比例近似计算；若需要精确的单侧决策界值或期中停试规则，可参考后续 ’Hern 或 Simon 场景。 数学公式与出处： \[n = \frac{\left[ Z_{\alpha/2}\sqrt{p_0(1-p_0)} + Z_{\beta}\sqrt{p_1(1-p_1)} \right]^2}{(p_1 - p_0)^2}\] 出处：Hajian-Tilaki, K. (2014). J Biomed Inform, 48, 193-204 (Eq 6.8). 输出解读与招募安排：需要 153 名患者的可判定主要结局。人数是为区分 70% 与 80% 的假设设定，不能据此承诺真实治疗反应率一定达到 80%。
code: res_2_4 <- calculate("rctSingleArm", "test", "proportion", p0 = 0.70, p1 = 0.80, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_2_4) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Single-arm trial (binary, vs fixed value)" #> • Required sample size: 153 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • p0 = null/historical control proportion #> • p1 = anticipated treatment proportion #> Formula (plain text): #> `n = [Za*sqrt(p0q0) + Zb*sqrt(p1q1)]^2/(p1-p0)^2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n = \frac{\left[Z_{\alpha/2}\sqrt{p_0(1-p_0)} + Z_{\beta}\sqrt{p_1(1-p_1)}\right]^2}{(p_1 - p_0)^2}$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Single-arm binary hypotheses: H0: p = 0.70 vs H1: p = 0.80 (alpha = #> 0.05, power = 0.80). #> • Step 2: Determine critical values: Z_(alpha/2) = 1.96, Z_beta = 0.8416. #> • Step 3: Sample size: n = [Z_(alpha/2)*sqrt(p0*q0) + Z_beta*sqrt(p1*q1)]^2 / #> (p1 - p0)^2 = 152.48. #> • Step 4: Round up to integer: Required sample size n = 153. #> Reference: #> Primary: Hajian-Tilaki, K. (2014). Sample size estimation in diagnostic test studies of biomedical informatics. Journal of Biomedical Informatics, 48, 193-204 (Eq 6.8; worked example 0.70 vs 0.80 -> n=153). #>  #>  Also: Akoglu, H. (2022). Table 2, Equation 2; Machin et al. (2018) Ch.3. #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

id: 单臂肿瘤-ii-期simon-两阶段最优设计optimal
previous_headings: 第二章：配对、单臂与交叉临床试验
what: 2.5 单臂肿瘤 II 期：Simon 两阶段最优设计（Optimal）
title: SampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 研究背景与人群：肿瘤科拟对有可测量病灶、既往治疗线数一致的晚期肉瘤患者开展单臂 II 期研究，希望在药物无效时尽早停止招募。 实施与主要结局：主要结局为治疗后约 8 周、按预设标准确认的客观缓解。第一阶段患者应完成相应观察后再进行正式无效性判断，阶段间需预留评估和数据核实时间。 参数设定与依据：设不可接受反应率 p0 = 0.10、值得继续开发的反应率 p1 = 0.30，单侧 α=0.05、效能 80%。两个率应对应同样的疾病亚型和缓解定义。 设计选择：optimizer = "optimal" 使零假设下的期望入组人数尽可能小；代价是最大总人数可能高于 minimax 方案。 数学公式与出处：完全精确二项网格穷举搜索，Simon, R. (1989). Controlled Clin Trials, 10(1), 1-10。设计 \((r_1/n_1, r/n)\) 需同时满足 \(P(\text{有效}\mid p_0) \le \alpha\) 与 \(P(\text{有效}\mid p_1) \ge 1-\beta\)。 输出解读与执行规则：第一阶段入组 10 人，缓解数≤1 时因无效停止；否则再入组 19 人，总数最多 29 人。最终总缓解数需>5，即至少 6 人，才能拒绝零假设。两个阶段的人数是包含关系，不是另外再招募一个总样本量。
code: res_2_5 <- calculate("singleArmPhaseII", "test", "proportion", p0 = 0.10, p1 = 0.30, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8, optimizer = "optimal") print(res_2_5) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Single-arm phase II (Simon two-stage, optimal)" #> • Stage 1 sample size: 10 #> • Stage 1 futility boundary (stop if responses <= r1): 1 #> • Total sample size (both stages): 29 #> • Overall boundary (declare effective if responses > r): 5 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • p0 = unacceptable response rate (null) #> • p1 = desirable response rate (alternative) #> • stage 1: stop for futility if responses <= r_stage_1 of n_stage_1 #> • overall: declare effective if responses > r_total of n_total #> Formula (plain text): #> `exact binomial: P(effective|p0) <= alpha and P(effective|p1) >= power` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$P(\text{reject } H_0 \mid p_0) \le \alpha \quad \text{and} \quad P(\text{reject } H_0 \mid p_1) \ge 1-\beta$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: State phase II hypotheses: H0: p <= 0.10 (unacceptable) vs H1: p >= #> 0.30 (promising) (alpha = 0.05, power = 0.80). #> • Step 2: Exhaustive exact binomial search under 'optimal' criterion. #> • Step 3: Stage 1: Accrue n1 = 10 patients; stop early for futility if #> responses <= r1 = 1. #> • Step 4: Stage 2: If > 1 responses observed, accrue additional 19 patients up #> to total n = 29. #> • Step 5: Final decision: Declare effective if total responses > r = 5 #> (Expected sample size under H0 = 15). #> Reference: #> Primary: Simon, R. (1989). Optimal two-stage designs for phase II clinical trials. Controlled Clinical Trials, 10(1), 1-10. #>  #>  Also: Machin et al. (2018) Chapter 17 (Therapeutic Exploratory Trials). #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>

id: 单臂肿瘤-ii-期simon-两阶段极小极大设计minimax
previous_headings: 第二章：配对、单臂与交叉临床试验
what: 2.6 单臂肿瘤 II 期：Simon 两阶段极小极大设计（Minimax）
title: SampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 研究背景与人群：同样研究晚期肉瘤的单臂 II 期治疗，但中心药物供应和可招募病例数有明确上限，研究者更关心任何情况下最多需要多少人。 实施与主要结局：仍以统一时间窗内的客观缓解为二分类终点，在两个阶段之间按预设界值决定是否继续；不能在期中观察后切换优化标准。 参数设定与依据：保持 p0 = 0.10、p1 = 0.30、α=0.05、效能 80%，仅把 optimizer 改为 "minimax"，以便在相同错误率约束下比较资源需求。 设计选择：minimax 最小化最大总人数，不保证零假设下的期望人数也最小；期中评估、药物准备与中心预算应同时比较两种方案。 输出解读与执行规则：第一阶段 15 人，缓解数≤1 时停止；继续时总入组最多 25 人，最终缓解数需>5。该最大总人数可与 optimal 方案的 29 人直接比较。
code: res_2_6 <- calculate("singleArmPhaseII", "test", "proportion", p0 = 0.10, p1 = 0.30, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8, optimizer = "minimax") print(res_2_6) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "Single-arm phase II (Simon two-stage, minimax)" #> • Stage 1 sample size: 15 #> • Stage 1 futility boundary (stop if responses <= r1): 1 #> • Total sample size (both stages): 25 #> • Overall boundary (declare effective if responses > r): 5 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • p0 = unacceptable response rate (null) #> • p1 = desirable response rate (alternative) #> • stage 1: stop for futility if responses <= r_stage_1 of n_stage_1 #> • overall: declare effective if responses > r_total of n_total #> ! Multiple designs may achieve the minimum total sample size N; #> ! this implementation selects the design minimizing Type I error (alpha) among ties. #>  #> Formula (plain text): #> `exact binomial: P(effective|p0) <= alpha and P(effective|p1) >= power` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$P(\text{reject } H_0 \mid p_0) \le \alpha \quad \text{and} \quad P(\text{reject } H_0 \mid p_1) \ge 1-\beta$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: State phase II hypotheses: H0: p <= 0.10 (unacceptable) vs H1: p >= #> 0.30 (promising) (alpha = 0.05, power = 0.80). #> • Step 2: Exhaustive exact binomial search under 'minimax' criterion. #> • Step 3: Stage 1: Accrue n1 = 15 patients; stop early for futility if #> responses <= r1 = 1. #> • Step 4: Stage 2: If > 1 responses observed, accrue additional 10 patients up #> to total n = 25. #> • Step 5: Final decision: Declare effective if total responses > r = 5 #> (Expected sample size under H0 = 19.50). #> Reference: #> Primary: Simon, R. (1989). Optimal two-stage designs for phase II clinical trials. Controlled Clinical Trials, 10(1), 1-10. #>  #>  Also: Machin et al. id: 单臂肿瘤-ii-期ahern-单阶段精确二项设计

what: 2.7 单臂肿瘤 II 期：A’Hern 单阶段精确二项设计
title: SampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 研究背景与人群：另一家中心拟回答相同的肉瘤治疗问题，但病例招募集中、终点评估滞后，无法在招募过程中实施有实际作用的期中无效性分析。 实施与主要结局：所有受试者完成预设的客观缓解评估后，只进行一次正式统计决策；病例和缓解定义应与历史对照保持一致。 参数设定与依据：设 p0 = 0.10、p1 = 0.30、单侧 α=0.05、效能 80%，通过精确二项分布搜索可行的总人数及拒绝界值。 设计选择：’Hern 单阶段设计适合一次性决策。输出的 r_total 是“需超过”的无效界值，达到等于该界值的缓解数还不足以拒绝零假设。 数学公式与出处：\(P(X > r \mid p_0) \le \alpha\) 且 \(P(X > r \mid p_1) \ge 1-\beta\)；’Hern, R. P. (2001). Statistics Medicine, 20(6), 859-866（doi:10.1002/sim.721）。 输出解读与执行规则：需 25 人，至少出现 6 例缓解才拒绝零假设。这里使用 X > r_total，与部分文献把“最少成功数”直接记作 r 的记号不同。

P. (2001). Sample size tables for exact single-stage phase II designs. title: SampleSizeCalc 完整使用指南：全场景临床科研样本量计算（零基础到精通）
text: 研究背景与人群：呼吸科拟在病情稳定、能完成重复肺功能检查的哮喘患者中，比较两种短效吸入制剂，随机分配 AB 或 BA 给药顺序。 实施与主要结局：每名患者在两个研究期分别接受一种制剂，按统一给药后时间测量 FEV1 占预计值的百分比。洗脱时间需按药效持续时间预先确定，并控制背景治疗及测试条件。 参数设定与依据：拟检出的治疗差为 delta = 2 个百分点，单次期内误差的个体内 SD 为 sigma_within = 3；它与两次观测差值的 SD 不是同一个参数。 设计选择：采用 2×2 交叉均数设计，双侧 α=0.05、效能 80%。稳定病情和可忽略的残留效应是交叉方案的重要前提，两个序列还需保持人数平衡。 数学公式与出处： \[n = \frac{2(Z_{\alpha/2} + Z_{\beta})^2 \sigma_w^2}{\delta^2}\] 出处：Senn, S. (2002). Cross-Trials Clinical Research (2nd ed.). Wiley. 输出解读与招募安排：本函数给出每序列 18 人、合计 36 名患者，每人完成两个研究期。按 10% 的未完成比例预留，应为 20 人/序列，两个时期的测量次数不能当成独立患者数。
code: res_2_8 <- calculate("crossover", "test", "mean", delta = 2, sigma_within = 3, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8) print(res_2_8) #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results #> • Design type: "2x2 crossover trial (continuous)" #> • Required sample size: 18 #> • Total sample size: 36 #> Parameter roles #>  #> • delta = anticipated treatment difference (mu_T - mu_R) #> • sigma_within = within-subject standard deviation #> • n_required/n_per_sequence = subjects per sequence; total_n = 2 x that #> ! This is the normal-approximation form (Julious 2004 Eq 6.6; Machin Eq 11.4). Senn (2002) Section 9.5.1, Eq 9.18-9.20, refines it with a Student t correction (df = n - 2), which typically needs 1-2 extra subjects; use the returned total as a lower bound and add 2 for exact 80% power. #>  #> Formula (plain text): #> `n_total = 2 (Za/2 + Zb)^2 sigma_w^2 / delta^2 ; n_per_sequence = n_total/2` #> Formula (LaTeX): #> $$n_{\text{total}} = \frac{2(Z_{\alpha/2}+Z_{\beta})^2\sigma_w^2}{\delta^2}, \quad n_{\text{sequence}} = \frac{n_{\text{total}}}{2}$$ #> Calculation process: #>  #> • Step 1: Identify study design: 2x2 crossover trial (continuous). #> • Step 2: Input parameters: delta = 2, sigma_within = 3, alpha = 0.05, power = #> 0.80. #> • Step 3: Apply design formula: n_total = 2 (Za/2 + Zb)^2 sigma_w^2 / delta^2 ; #> n_per_sequence = n_total/2. #> • Step 4: Calculated sample size metrics: Required sample size: 18; Total #> sample size: 36. #> Reference: #> Primary: Senn, S. (2002). Cross-over Trials in Clinical Research (2nd ed.). Wiley. Section 9.5 'Sample-size issues', Eq 9.18-9.20, pp. 278-280 (sigma^2 = 2 sigma_w^2 for a basic estimator, Var = sigma^2/n, df = n - 2, n = total patients with n/2 per sequence). #>  #>  Also: Julious, S. A. (2004). Tutorial in biostatistics: sample sizes for clinical trials with normal data. Statistics in Medicine, 23(12), 1921-1986 (Section 6.3 'Cross-over trials', Eq 6.3/6.6; n there is the total sample size, and the reported quantity is per sequence). #> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #>
